 [REPLAY] Adam Blitz – Inside Hedge Fund Allocation (Capital Allocators, EP.17) May 29, 2023

 
Adam Blitz is the CEO and Chief Investment Officer of Evanston
Capital Management, a $4.5 billion hedge fund of funds manager with
a decade and a half of experience managing hedge fund portfolios.
Adam joined Evanston at its inception in 2002 and leads investment
research and portfolio management. Previously, he worked in the
Prime Brokerage area and Asset Management Division of Goldman Sachs
and served as head trader at AQR.  Adam earned a B.S. in
Economics at the Wharton School.

 
Our conversation dives in the hedge fund category of investing,
covering how a leading allocator in the space thinks about
strategic asset allocation, portfolio construction, risk
management, manager research, decision making, and monitoring
managers. Adam’s perspective on the evolution in how allocators
perceive hedge funds and the resulting unattractiveness of the
“average hedge fund” today resonate strongly with how I’ve viewed
this widely discussed and recently scrutinized corner of the
markets.

Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
